welcome.title: Welcome to the show editor
welcome.body: Take a minute to meet the main areas. Press Esc to skip any time; click ? at the top right (or press F1) to replay the tour or show the tips on this page.

library.title: Library
library.body:
The icons on the left switch sections: fixtures, cue templates, media, effects, presets, groups and history; click the current icon again to hide the library (Ctrl+Shift+B).
Add fixtures first: + adds one, the arrow opens batch add, or drag a card onto Patch, the stage or the timeline. Drag templates and effects onto the timeline, or click to add them to the selected track.

preview.title: Preview
preview.body:
Shows each fixture's color at the playhead. Swatches are the default, grouped by universe and sorted by address; switch to Stage or Sheet any time — your choice is remembered.
Click swatches to select fixtures, Ctrl to add, Shift for a range.

inspector.title: Inspector
inspector.body:
Fixtures & Patch (the fixture list on top, properties and actions for the selection below), Programmer (set values on selected fixtures), and Cue properties (color, keyframes, spread).
Clicking a timeline track header selects and reveals its fixtures; the button at the right of the title hides the panel (Ctrl+Alt+B).

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.body:
Double-click empty space to add a clip, drag to move, drag an edge to trim. The icon at a clip's top-left and its top stripe show the type (color, effect, preset, scene); the ? at the right of the toolbar is the legend.
Right-click for the context menu; Q / W trim left / right of the playhead, Ctrl+B splits; Ctrl / Shift on track headers selects several tracks.
Markers, sections and the loop range: select and press Delete, or right-click / hover × — you can undo.

mode.title: Live mode / Playback mode
mode.body: Live mode receives and forwards external signals; Playback mode outputs your show. You'll be asked to confirm before switching.

shortcuts.title: Handy shortcuts
shortcuts.body:
Ctrl+K command palette (every action is searchable)
Space play / pause, J / K / L back one frame / pause / play
Shift+Q radial menu, Shift+F10 context menu
The ? menu (F1) has the shortcut cheat sheet, what's new, feedback, the tour and page tips.

swatches.title: Swatch groups and legend
swatches.body:
Group by universe, group or model; collapse a section or select it all at once.
Dot = in programmer, red border = address conflict, stripes = mirror addresses, bottom bar = level.

trackHeaders.title: Select several tracks
trackHeaders.body: Ctrl-click a track header to add it, Shift-click for a range. Double-click, templates and paste then apply to every selected track; right-click for sync, group and delete.

patchBatch.title: Batch fixture settings
patchBatch.body: Summary and actions for the selected fixtures. With several selected, Basics renames them with a pattern like “Front {n}”, DMX address patches them in sequence, and Batch sync copies mode, height, rotation and hanging from the first one; fields that differ show “mixed”.

universeView.title: Universe cards and channel grid
universeView.body: Cards lay out every fixture by address (same model, same color); the grid shows all 512 channels. Hovering highlights the fixture on the stage too.

colorInput.title: Two ways to pick a color
colorInput.body: “Color” has two input methods: the wheel (HSV, with H / S / V fields next to it) and RGB values; the editor remembers your last choice.

timelineObjects.title: Deleting markers, sections and loops
timelineObjects.body: Select a marker or section and press Delete, hover and click ×, or right-click. For the loop range, hover the ruler band and click ×. Undo from the toast.

templates.title: Templates come from a config file
templates.body: Templates are grouped; right-click to copy, rename, move or delete. The toolbar imports / exports template files, shows the file in its folder, and reloads it after you edit it.

fixtureAdd.title: Three ways to add fixtures
fixtureAdd.body: + adds one; the arrow opens batch add with quantity, start address, gap and name, previewing the channels it will use; or hold the handle and drag a fixture onto a Patch universe card, the stage or the timeline.

effects.title: Tune, then insert
effects.body: Clicking an effect opens its parameters: speed, size, phase spread, wings, direction and order; then press Insert. Double-click inserts right away. Effects come from config files; right-click to copy one into your own effects.

programmer.title: New programmer tools
programmer.body: “Highlight” turns the selected fixtures full white so you can step through them with Alt+← / Alt+→. Below you'll find attributes, fan (A→B) and the programmer's own undo. Every section has a “?” with details.

guide.hintsShown: Showing all tips on this page; click a dot to read it

overview.short: Set different values on several fixtures at once, then record them to the timeline.

highlight.title: Highlight
highlight.short: Selected fixtures go full white temporarily; step through them with Prev / Next.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.short: Set the brightness of the selected fixtures; quick buttons for full, zero and ±10%.

color.title: Color
color.short: Pick a color; each fixture mixes it with its own emitters.

attrs.title: Attributes
attrs.short: Set pan / tilt, gobos, zoom and other non-color attributes the selection supports.

fan.title: Fan
fan.short: Spread intensity, hue or an attribute from A to B across the selection order.

record.title: Record
record.short: Record the programmer as a scene clip, as clips on each track, or update the selected clips.
record.keys: Alt+R record scene clip · Alt+Shift+R record to own tracks

swatches.title: Preview swatches
swatches.short: One swatch per fixture showing its actual color at the playhead; select fixtures and spot problems here.
swatches.keys: Arrows move · Shift+arrows extend · Ctrl+A select all · Esc clear

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.short: Arrange cues, edit by time range and organise tracks.
timeline.keys: Shift+drag ruler select range · Z zoom to range · Alt+Shift+Delete delete range · Alt+Shift+G insert gap · Ctrl+Shift+V paste at mouse · Alt+Shift+↑/↓ move track · Shift+↑/↓ previous / next marker
timeline.term: Time Range · Ripple · Align / Quantize · Insert Time

shortcutSheet.title: Shortcut cheat sheet
shortcutSheet.description: Every shortcut by category, including your custom ones. Most shortcuts are ignored while typing in a field.

whatsNew.title: What's new
whatsNew.description: The main changes in this version.

fixtureAdd.title: Easier batch add
fixtureAdd.body: Search and filter fixtures by type; the add panel sets quantity, mode, start address, gap and a name template, previews the channels it will use, and can group the new fixtures.

fixtureDrag.title: Drag to add fixtures
fixtureDrag.body: Drag a fixture card onto a Patch universe card (patched from the drop address), the stage monitor (placed at the drop point) or the timeline.

fixtureLibrary.title: Redesigned fixture library
fixtureLibrary.body: Type icons and filters in the list; the detail view shows capability badges, key parameters and a channel strip colored by attribute group with a legend; add to the current show in one click.

effectLibrary.title: Effect library from config files
effectLibrary.body: 24 built-in attribute effects (position, intensity, color, beam) with speed, size, phase spread, wings, direction and order set before inserting; your own effects live in effects.json and can be imported and exported.

timelineTools.title: Timeline tools
timelineTools.body: Zoom slider and fit, follow playhead, snap options, ripple edit, expand or collapse all tracks, and a ruler that switches between timecode and bars·beats.

recentFiles.title: Recent files
recentFiles.body: The File menu lists the last 10 shows you opened; an empty show's preview shows the latest 5.

outputAdvanced.title: Basic and advanced output settings
outputAdvanced.body: Output target and routing stay visible; gamma, latency compensation, sync and parked channels move under Advanced.

helpMenu.title: Help menu
helpMenu.body: Adds a shortcut cheat sheet, what's new, feedback (copy diagnostics, open log folder) and About.

modeDesc.0: Auto: simplified, same as Program (playback only, no forwarding).
modeDesc.1: Art-Net Forward: stops playback, receives network Art-Net / sACN live and merges the output.
modeDesc.2: Loop: records the mode only, stops playback, no other behavior.
modeDesc.3: Scene: records the mode only, stops playback, no other behavior.
modeDesc.4: Program: stops forwarding and allows playing program files by number.
modeDesc.5: Effect: records the mode only, stops playback, no other behavior.
